stem.text: The vertical forces that the ground exerts on a stationary van are shown.

stem.alt: Van on a horizontal ground line with upward force arrows labelled 16 000 N under the front wheel and 9000 N under the rear wheel, and horizontal dimension arrows labelled 0.600 m, 1.500 m and 0.400 m.

stem.text: The van is $2.50\,\text{m}$ long with the wheels at a distance of $0.600\,\text{m}$ from the front of the van and $0.400\,\text{m}$ from the rear of the van.
What is the horizontal distance of the van’s centre of gravity from the front of the van?
